representation.name: Broad-Domain Door Component Field
representation.component_rule: Raw eight-connected class-union components whose box bottom reaches at least half image height; rank by semantic pixel area.

development.gate: Top-3 truth at least 3/4 and no-portal false presence 0/2
development.interpretation: Changing the training-domain information source reversed SPPF's failure: door-level recall rose from 0/4 to 3/4 while both no-portal and both scale-OOD controls remained absent.

next_step: Freeze the selected normalized component-area threshold and run one new entity-disjoint SCIL plus BD-DCF confirmation. Do not use the consumed PB6 pixels for promotion.
claim_boundary: Development-only evidence on the consumed PB6 cohort. The coarse component boxes are set-valued portal regions, not precise door-leaf localization, physical ownership, public access, opening state, traversability, active-view causality, guidance, arrival, user benefit, or safety evidence.
